weaknesses.critique: I failed to recognize that the computed figures provided show FY2026 revenue of $215,938 million and FY2025 revenue of $130,497 million, yielding a year-over-year growth rate of 65.47%, which clearly exceeds 50%. The numeric_checks section explicitly shows this calculation with status 'TRUE' and references evidence_ids E7, E8, and E9 that I was not provided in the original evidence list but which apparently contain the actual revenue figures from the 10-K filings.

I incorrectly concluded there was INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when the system had already computed the relevant figures from the filings. The instructions state I should use 'computed figures supplied' to me, and the numeric_checks clearly provide computed revenue values for both fiscal years with their sources, even though those specific evidence passages were not included in my evidence list.

My reasoning focused only on the evidence passages E1-E6 that were explicitly provided to me, but I should have recognized that the computed figures in the numeric_checks section represent authoritative calculations from the actual 10-K filings (E7, E8, E9) that contain the consolidated statements of income with total revenue figures for both fiscal years.
